Confidence band of a QQ plot as an SVG path

Source: R/gwas_helpers.R
INTERNAL_gwas_qq_band.Rd

The ci.level interval of the i-th smallest of n uniform p-values is given by the Beta(i, n - i + 1) quantiles. It is evaluated at up to points log-spaced ranks, which is plenty for a smooth outline and keeps the shape small for millions of variants.

Usage

.gwas_qq_band(n, ci.level = 0.95, points = 300)

Arguments

n

Number of variants.

ci.level

Confidence level.

points

Number of ranks to evaluate.

Value

An SVG path string in data coordinates (expected, observed -log10 p).
